description:
Hi, we’re The Event Horizon! Three curious 14–15-year-olds who love tech and space :)

Ofir: Loves math and particle physics. Studies Software Engineering (42 credit units) at Ilan Ramon High School in Hod HaSharon and is part of the Mamriot program.

Yuval: Ofir’s classmate in Software Engineering, and part of both TAUs AI4Y and the Mamriot programs.

Ethan: Loves math, physics, CS and space, and is working toward a B.Sc. in Computer Science after years of coding, mainly in machine learning.
